title: Bitcoin $100K: five mainstream developments

proposedStudy.question: Which developments most changed the chance Bitcoin would reach $100,000 in 2024?
proposedStudy.orientation: Rank five accessible regulatory, policy, macro, supply, and adoption developments without seeing the threshold contract’s own price record.

market.title: Will Bitcoin hit $100k in 2024?
market.rules: Resolves YES if any Coinbase BTC-USD one-minute candle from January 1 through December 31, 2024 has a final high of at least $100,000; otherwise NO.

contract.proposition: Bitcoin reaches $100,000 during 2024 on Coinbase BTC-USD

events.title: Hong Kong launches spot Bitcoin and Ether ETFs
events.mechanism: A new regulated access channel can broaden institutional demand and validate spot-ETF adoption outside the United States.

claims.text: Six spot virtual-asset ETFs began trading in Hong Kong, including products holding Bitcoin directly.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The launch expanded access, though initial flows were modest relative to U.S. products.
events.competingExplanation: Bitcoin was also reacting to global risk assets and post-halving positioning.

events.title: Mt. Gox trustee begins Bitcoin repayments
events.mechanism: Distributing long-locked coins creates a credible near-term source of selling and uncertainty about creditor behavior.

claims.text: The rehabilitation trustee announced repayments in Bitcoin and Bitcoin Cash to some creditors through designated exchanges under the rehabilitation plan.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The announcement reinforced supply-overhang concerns already visible in crypto markets.
events.competingExplanation: German government wallet sales and broad risk-off conditions overlapped the same period.

events.title: Federal Reserve opens easing cycle with a 50-point cut
events.mechanism: Lower rates and easier financial conditions can support demand for scarce, non-yielding risk assets.

claims.text: The FOMC lowered the federal funds target range by 50 basis points to 4.75%–5.00%.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The cut improved the liquidity backdrop but also conveyed concern about economic weakness.
events.competingExplanation: The size of the cut had repriced substantially before the statement.

events.title: Trump wins the 2024 presidential election
events.mechanism: A change in administration can alter enforcement priorities, agency leadership, and the probability of crypto-friendly legislation.

claims.text: The Associated Press declared Donald Trump the winner of the U.S. presidential race and elected the 47th president.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The result reduced policy uncertainty for crypto investors.
events.competingExplanation: Bitcoin was also moving with a broad post-election risk rally and dollar-rate repricing.

events.title: MicroStrategy discloses a 27,200 BTC purchase
events.mechanism: A large disclosed corporate purchase provides direct demand and can validate a leveraged treasury-adoption strategy for other firms.

claims.text: MicroStrategy disclosed that it acquired approximately 27,200 bitcoin for approximately $2.03 billion in cash between October 31 and November 10.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The filing confirmed substantial institutional demand during the post-election rally.
events.competingExplanation: Most purchases occurred before disclosure, and price momentum itself enabled financing demand.
